---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature for KOBRA scanner
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 🎯 Feature Description

Clear and concise description of what you want to add.

## 💡 Use Case

**Why** is this needed? What problem does it solve?

Example:
- Current modules miss detecting X vulnerability class
- Output format needs improvement
- Integration with other tools is missing

## 🔧 Proposed Implementation

How would you implement this? (Optional but helpful)

- New module path: `src/scan/<name>.rs`
- Detection technique: (e.g., timing-based, error-based, OOB)
- Estimated complexity: (easy / medium / hard)

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you think about?

## 📚 References

- CVE numbers, blog posts, papers
- Similar tools (nuclei, ffuf, dalfox)
- OWASP/CWE classifications

## ⚖️ Priority

How important is this to you?

- [ ] Critical (blocks my work)
- [ ] High (would significantly improve)
- [ ] Medium (nice to have)
- [ ] Low (minor enhancement)
